answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the terrace record and indexed in the juniper history, the meadow audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 124 aliases thus needs 124 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 2 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
